text:
FYI: Two bills are being brought about by the liberals and RINOS from both the House and the Senate!
Both of these bills can and WILL be used to deny access to any site they wish to block us from! Like TGP! Or any site you can think of. All in the guise of protecting copyrights holders.
This is a lie!
From the House and by California Rep. Darrel Issa called the American Copyright Protection Act (ACPA) and the one from the Senate introduced by Senator Thom Tillis and Rep. Zoe Lofgren : the DEFEND IP Act.
Both bills are supported by democrats; with Schumer supporting the bill from the Senate. That should be enough for you to know that these bills are wrong and are just a veiled attempt to take away our right to go to sites we want; as in TGP for example!
While Tillis' protects VPN's BOTH acts are very detrimental to our freedom, privacy and an infringement to our US Constitution.
On the surface they may appear to be protecting "hoollywierd" and their copyrights; they are not.
Both are attempting to deny Americans their rights to freely navigate the internet.
Because BOTH or attempting to block sites, not crimes, but sites. This is evil and anti-freedom.
It isn't illegal to go to a site; that isn't a crime. But they want to take away our right to navigate there.
Again this may seem trivial. However, we all know how abusive our government can be.
They can use this bill to DENY Americans to ANY site.
Take TGP for example! Or any site you wish!
They can take that away from you and you can't do anything about it!
This doesn't even take into account all the incorrect or accidental sites to be blocked.
Both of these bills are attempting to take away our freedoms and can eventually be used to take away, permanently, our right to gather and read news we determine to be true and not their truth!
Both bills are very evil and should be blocked!
